0.FDO/Description.0.FDO/StringSyntax: Description of the obligation and repeatability of values in an FDO. Must follow the regular expression: ^(\d+)(\.\.(\d+|\*))?$. Examples: 1 (mandatory), 0..1 (optional), 1..* (mandatory and repeatable), 0..* (optional and repeatable), 2..3 (MUST occur two to three times).
